scope: Historical source snapshot, not installed or executable payload
content:
# ADR gate — gap-audit G40.
# An architectural change with no ADR used to pass every gate (enforcement was
# prose-only). This fails a PR whose diff touches architectural surfaces
# (globs in .claude/adr-surfaces.txt) unless the same PR adds/updates a file
# under .claude/memory/decisions/ or a commit references an ADR.
name: adr-gate

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  adr-gate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Check architectural surfaces vs ADR presence
        run: |
          set -uo pipefail
          base="origin/${{ github.base_ref }}"
          git fetch origin "${{ github.base_ref }}" --depth=50 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
          changed=$(git diff --name-only "$base"...HEAD)
          [ -z "$changed" ] && { echo "no changes"; exit 0; }

          surfaces=".claude/adr-surfaces.txt"
          [ -f "$surfaces" ] || { echo "no $surfaces — gate skipped"; exit 0; }

          touched_arch=""
          while IFS= read -r glob; do
            case "$glob" in ''|'#'*) continue ;; esac
            # shell-glob match each changed path against the pattern
            while IFS= read -r f; do
              case "$f" in
                $glob) touched_arch="$touched_arch $f" ;;
              esac
            done <<< "$changed"
          done < "$surfaces"

          if [ -z "$touched_arch" ]; then
            echo "✓ no architectural surfaces touched"
            exit 0
          fi

          echo "Architectural surfaces touched:$touched_arch"

          if echo "$changed" | grep -q '^\.claude/memory/decisions/.*\.md$'; then
            echo "✓ ADR added/updated in this PR"
            exit 0
          fi
          if git log "$base"...HEAD --format='%B' | grep -qiE 'ADR[-: ]?[0-9]{4}|\.claude/memory/decisions/'; then
            echo "✓ commit references an ADR"
            exit 0
          fi

          echo "✗ Architectural surfaces changed with no ADR."
          echo "  Create one: bash .claude/scripts/adr-new.sh \"<title>\" --by human --subsystem <key>"
          echo "  (or cite an existing ADR-NNNN in the commit body; surfaces list: $surfaces)"
          exit 1
